quote: Notwithstanding Section 14.3, Supplier may assign or transfer this Agreement... without the consent of Customer, to (a) any Affiliate of Supplier; or (b) any successor to Supplier by merger, consolidation, change of control or sale... A "change of control" assignment means that if Supplier is acquired by a competitor of Harrowgate or by a financially weaker entity, Harrowgate is stuck with the new owner... The arrangement is entirely one-sided: Customer still needs Supplier's consent to assign under original §14.3.
reason: The memo identifies the right provision: new §14.4 added by Amendment No. 1 §4 (the memo cites §4.1), which overrides §14.3. It states that Veltmar can assign without consent to Affiliates and to successors by merger, change of control or sale of business. It explains the competitor risk and that Harrowgate remains bound by consent, so the restriction is one-sided. All elements of the criterion are covered.
